full_judgment:
Mr. J.R. Mudasir Hossain has submitted that compensation with respect to the lands of khatian No. 349 have been prepared and finally published and that compensation for acquisition of the suit lands have been received by the landlords. 

 8. We have perused the certified copy of the khatian placed before us. In this khatian we find that there are tanks and khas lands owned by the shebait on behalf of the deities. In the khatian there are tenanted lands as well. In our view compensation assessment roll must have been prepared with respect to re It receiving interests in the khatian. Nothing could be shown that the compensation assessment roll have been prepared and compensation has been received by the landlords with respect to the khas lands of the khatian.
